text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And so, here you go, your birthday 
present!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh my, thank you very much, Falco-san.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's an acrylic bead set. I really, really 
hope you'll use them for bead knitting!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The iridescent aurora colors were so cute! 
I just thought it'd look super pretty on 
you, Acute-san~!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, "All Lacquer"? What kind of color is 
that, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Uhh... how should I put it? Like a shiny, 
iridescent rainbow sort of... faintly 
layered over it? You know what I mean~?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes! Exactly, exactly, exactly! As 
expected of Acute-san!
